He jested constantly, shunned grain and brocade, lived on breath discipline, and shunned society. He herded hundreds of pupils into cliff caverns near Dongyang. When Shi Hu's regime collapsed he left his flock for Chang'an and built a hidden hut on Zhongnan. Students found him again, so he relocated to Mount Daoshou. Fu Jian's repeated calls went ignored while nobles and scholars made pilgrimages to study under him. He fielded contemporary questions without hesitation. He spoke in riddling parables like a comic. His future-tense riddles baffled listeners until hindsight proved each clue.
83
堅將南征，遣使者問之。 嘉曰：「金剛火強。 」乃乘使者馬，正衣冠，徐徐東行數百步，而策馬馳反，脫衣服，棄冠履而歸，下馬踞床，一無所言。 使者還告，堅不語，復遣問之，曰：「吾世祚云何？ 」嘉曰：「未央。 」咸以為吉。 明年癸未，敗於淮南，所謂未年而有殃也。 人侯之者，至心則見之，不至心則隱形不見。 衣服在架，履杖猶存，或欲取其衣者，終不及，企而取之，衣架逾高，而屋亦不大，覆杖諸物亦如之。
On the eve of Fu Jian's southern campaign an envoy sought his oracle. Wang Jia answered with the gnomic line "Vajra fierce, fire fierce." He borrowed the courier's mount, paraded eastward, wheeled at a gallop, shed cap and boots, then sat mute on a bench. The baffled envoy reported; Fu Jian sent again to ask how long his line would endure. Wang Jia replied "Weiyang," which courtiers misread as endless blessing. Everyone took it for a promise of enduring rule. The next year guiwei brought disaster at Fei River—"not ended" had meant the wei year would still know woe. He appeared only to the utterly sincere and stayed invisible to half-hearted callers. His robe and staff seemed ordinary yet eluded grasp, the rack rising when stretched for, though the chamber never widened.
84
姚萇之入長安，禮嘉如苻堅故事，逼以自隨，每事諮之。 萇既與苻登相持，問嘉曰：「吾得殺苻登定天下不？ 」嘉曰：「略得之。 」萇怒曰：「得當云得，何略之有！ 」遂斬之。 先此，釋道安謂嘉曰：「世故方殷，可以行矣。 」嘉答曰：「卿其先行，吾負債未果去。 」俄而道安亡，至是而嘉戮死，所謂「負債」者也。 苻登聞嘉死，設壇哭之，贈太師，諡曰文。 及萇死，萇子興字子略方殺登，「略得」之謂也。 嘉之死日，人有隴上見之。 其所造《牽三歌讖》，事過皆驗，累世猶傳之。 又著《拾遺錄》十卷，其記事多詭怪，今行於世。
Yao Chang, conquering Chang'an, courted Wang Jia as Fu Jian had and dragooned him into counsel. During the standoff with Fu Deng, Yao Chang asked whether he could slay his rival and pacify the realm. Wang Jia answered, "You will gain it in part." Yao Chang fumed that victory should be total, not partial. He had Wang Jia beheaded in wrath. Earlier Shih Dao'an had urged him to flee mounting chaos. Wang Jia answered that Dao'an should leave first while he still owed fate a reckoning. Dao'an died soon after; Wang Jia's execution fulfilled the dark sense of "debt." Fu Deng mourned him with rites and posthumous honors as Grand Preceptor Wen. Yao Chang's son Yao Xing, whose courtesy was Zilue, later slew Fu Deng—fulfilling the cryptic "partial gain." The day he died, witnesses still saw him walking the Long plateau. His doggerel prophecy cycle proved true in every line and stayed in folk memory. His ten-scroll miscellany of marvels remains in print.
85
僧涉
The monk She (Seng She)
86
僧涉者，西域人也，不知何姓。 少為沙門，苻堅時入長安。 虛靜服氣，不食五穀，日能行五百里，言未然之事，驗若指掌。 能以秘祝下神龍，每旱，堅常使之咒龍請雨。 俄而龍下缽中，天輒大雨，堅及群臣親就缽觀之。 卒于長安。 後大旱移時，苻堅歎曰：「涉公若在，豈憂此乎！」
Seng She came from the Western Regions; his family name was lost. He tonsured young and reached Chang'an under Fu Jian. He lived on breath, crossed five hundred li daily without grain, and foretold the future with uncanny precision. He summoned rain-dragons by esoteric spells whenever drought struck. A dragon coiled in an alms bowl and heaven opened; Fu Jian and his court peered in. He passed away in Chang'an. Years of drought later made Fu Jian lament that without She their rains would never return.
87
郭黁
Guo Wu
88
郭黁，西平人也。 少明《老》《易》，仕郡主簿。 張天錫末年，苻氏每有西伐之問，太守趙凝使黁筮之，黁曰：「若郡內二月十五日失囚者，東軍當至，涼祚必終。 」凝乃申約屬縣。 至十五日，鮮卑折掘送馬於凝，凝怒其非駿，幽之內廄，鮮卑懼而夜遁。 凝以告黁，黁曰：「是也。 國家將亡，不可復振。」
Guo Wu hailed from Xiping. Youthful mastery of the Laozi and Zhouyi won him the chief clerk's post. As Former Qin threatened Hexi, Prefect Zhao Ning had Guo Wu cast lots: a jailbreak on the fifteenth of the second month would herald eastern invasion and the fall of Former Liang. Zhao Ning wired every county to tighten the jails. On that day Xianbei herdsmen delivered horses Zhao Ning disliked and locked up, provoking a night stampede that broke custody. Zhao Ning told Guo Wu, who said the omen had struck. Former Liang was finished beyond recovery.
89
苻堅末，當陽門震，刺史梁熙問黁曰：「其祥安在？ 」黁曰：「為四夷之事也。 當有外國二王來朝主上，一當反國，一死此城。 」歲餘而鄯善及前部王朝於苻堅，西歸，鄯善王死于姑臧。
When Dangyang Gate shook late in Fu Jian's day, Governor Liang Xi asked Guo Wu what it portended. Guo Wu read it as a sign involving foreign powers. Two frontier kings would visit the throne: one would go home, the other would die in the capital. Within a year Shanshan and the anterior-branch Yarkand ruler paid homage to Fu Jian; the Shanshan ruler died at Guzang on the westward journey.
90
呂光之王河西也，西海太守王楨叛，黁勸光襲之。 光之左丞呂寶曰：「千里襲人，自昔所難，況王者之師天下所聞，何可僥倖以邀成功！ 黁不可從，誤人大事。 」黁曰：「若其不捷，黁自伏鈇鉞之誅。 如其克也，左丞為無謀矣。 」光從而克之。 光比之京管，常參帷幄密謀。
After Lü Guang took Hexi, rebel West Sea prefect Wang Zhen drew Guo Wu's advice to attack. Left aide Lü Bao warned that long-range surprise strikes were notorious gambles even for a celebrated royal army. He insisted Guo Wu's counsel would wreck the campaign. Guo Wu swore to face the headsman's axe if the raid failed. Victory would expose Lü Bao as the fool, he added. Lü Guang took the gamble and won. Lü Guang ranked him with Jing Fang and Guan Lu and kept him in secret strategy sessions.
91
光將伐乞伏乾歸，黁諫曰：「今太白未出，不宜行師，往必無功，終當覆敗。 」太史令賈曜以為必有秦隴之地。 及克金城，光使曜詰黁，黁密謂光曰：「昨有流星東墮，當有伏屍死將，雖得此城，憂在不守。 正月上旬，河冰將解，若不早渡，恐有大變。 」後二日而敗問至，光引軍渡河訖，冰泮。 時人服其神驗。 光以黁為散騎常侍、太常。
Before the Qifu GanGui campaign Guo Wu warned that Venus had not appeared and marching would end in rout. Court astrologer Jia Yao instead promised conquest of the Qin-Long region. After Jincheng fell, Guo Wu privately told Lü Guang a fallen meteor meant pyrrhic gain and shaky tenure. He urged an early river crossing before January ice broke. Two days later defeat news came; Lü Guang finished his crossing just as the floes parted. Contemporaries marveled at his precision. Lü Guang named him supernumerary cavalier and grand liturgist.
92
黁後以光年老，知其將敗，遂與光僕射王祥起兵作亂。 百姓聞黁起兵，咸以聖人起事，事無不成，故相率從之如不及。 黁以為代呂者王，乃推王乞基為主。 後呂隆降姚興，興以王尚為涼州刺史，終如黁言。 黁之與光相持也，逃人稱呂統病死，黁曰：「未也，光、統之命盡在一時。 」黁後統死三日而光死。 黁嘗曰：「涼州謙光殿后當有索頭鮮卑居之。 」終於禿髮傉檀、沮渠蒙遜迭據姑臧。 黁性褊酷，不為士庶所附。 戰敗，奔乞伏乾歸。 乾歸敗，入姚興。 黁以滅姚者晉，遂將妻子南奔，為追兵所殺也。
Seeing Lü Guang senile and doomed, Guo Wu joined Minister Wang Xiang in revolt. The populace mistook his rising for a saint-led sure victory and rushed to enlist. Reading the prophecy that Lü would yield to Wang, he enthroned Wang Qiji as figurehead. When Lü Long yielded to Later Qin, Yao Xing installed Wang Shang over Liang, fulfilling Guo Wu's line. During the standoff a rumor claimed Lü Tong had died; Guo Wu said both Lü lives would expire together. Lü Tong died first; Lü Guang followed three days later. He prophesied Suotou Xianbei occupation behind Liangzhou's modesty hall. Tufa Nutan and Juqu Mengxun alternately held Guzang, as he foretold. His harsh temper won him few loyal followers. Routed, he fled to Western Qin. After Qifu fell he entered Later Qin service. Believing Jin would end Yao rule, he bolted south with his family and died under pursuit.
93
鳩摩羅什
Kumarajiva
94
鳩摩羅什，天竺人也。 世為國相。 父鳩摩羅炎，聰懿有大節，將嗣相位，乃辭避出家，東渡蔥嶺。 龜茲王聞其名，郊迎之，請為國師。 王有妹，年二十，才悟明敏，諸國交娉，並不許，及見炎，心欲當之，王乃逼以妻焉。 既而羅什在胎，其母慧解倍常。 及年七歲，母遂與俱出家。
Kumarajiva was a native of India. His forebears had served as Indian premiers for generations. His father Kumarayan, brilliant and high-minded, renounced the hereditary premiership, took orders, and crossed the Pamirs east. The Kucha king welcomed him outside the walls and named him state chaplain. The princess, gifted and wooed by every realm, chose Kumarayan; the king compelled the match. She bore Kumarajiva with twice the usual wit. At seven he tonsured with his mother.
95
羅什從師受經，日誦千偈，偈有三十二字，凡三萬二千言，義亦自通。 年十二，其母攜到沙勒，國王甚重之，遂停沙勒一年。 博覽五明諸論及陰陽星算，莫不必盡，妙達吉凶，言若符契。 為性率達，不拘小檢，修行者頗共疑之。 然羅什自得於心，未嘗介意，專以大乘為化，諸學者皆共師焉。 年二十，龜茲王迎之還國，廣說諸經，四遠學徒莫之能抗。
He memorized a thousand thirty-two-character gathas daily—thirty-two thousand graphs—and grasped their sense unaided. At twelve he toured Shule, where the king detained him a year in honor. He mastered the five Buddhist sciences plus astrology and divination, speaking fate as if sealed by contract. His blunt, easygoing ways drew side-eyes from ascetics. He ignored the gossip, taught Mahayana, and became the schoolmen's master. Recalled to Kucha at twenty, he lectured rings of unmatched auditors.
96
有頃，羅什母辭龜茲王往天竺，留羅什住，謂之曰：「方等深教，不可思議，傳之東土，惟爾之力。 但於汝無利，其可如何？ 」什曰：「必使大化流傳，雖苦而無恨。 」母至天竺，道成，進登第三果。 西域諸國咸伏羅什神俊，每至講說，諸王皆長跪坐側，令羅什踐而登焉。 苻堅聞之，密有迎羅什之意。 會太史奏云：「有星見外國分野，當有大智入輔中國。 」堅曰：「朕聞西域有鳩摩羅什，將非此邪？ 」乃遣驍騎將軍呂光等率兵七萬，西伐龜茲，謂光曰：「若獲羅什，即馳驛送之。 」光軍未至，羅什謂龜茲王白純曰：「國運衰矣，當有勍敵從日下來，宜恭承之，勿抗其鋒。 」純不從，出兵距戰，光遂破之，乃獲羅什。 光見其年齒尚少，以凡人戲之，強妻以龜茲王女，羅什距而不受，辭甚苦至。 光曰：「道士之操不逾先父，何所固辭？ 」乃飲以醇酒，同閉密室。 羅什被逼，遂妻之。 光還，中路置軍於山下，將士已休，羅什曰：「在此必狼狽，宜徙軍隴上。 」光不納。 至夜，果大雨，洪潦暴起，水深數丈，死者數千人，光密異之。 光欲留王西國，羅什謂光曰：「此凶亡之地，不宜淹留，中路自有福地可居。 」光還至涼州，聞苻堅已為姚萇所害，於是竊號河右。 屬姑臧大風，羅什曰：「不祥之風當有奸叛，然不勞自定也。 」俄而有叛者，尋皆殄滅。
His mother left for India, leaving him in Kucha to carry Mahayana scripture eastward. She warned the mission would cost him personally. He vowed to spread the dharma regardless of personal pain. In India she attained arhatship's third fruit. Western kings knelt as steps for him to mount the dais, awed by his genius. Fu Jian coveted him from afar. The throne reported a foreign-field star heralding a sage for China. Fu Jian guessed it meant Kumarajiva. He dispatched Lü Guang with seventy thousand men to seize Kumarajiva and post him east at once. He warned King Bai Chun of Kucha to yield to the invader from the sunrise quarter. The king fought and lost; Lü Guang took the monk captive. Lü Guang mocked his youth, forced a royal princess on him, and met desperate refusal. Lü Guang sneered that a monk need not outdo his father's worldly marriage. He plied him with liquor and locked him in an inner room. Broken by coercion, Kumarajiva accepted the princess. On the march he warned against camping in a valley prone to flood. Lü Guang ignored him. Night rains drowned thousands in a flash flood, and Lü Guang secretly marveled. When Lü Guang meant to stay west, Kumarajiva called the site deadly and pointed to Liangzhou as the true seat. Lü Guang withdrew to Hexi, learned Fu Jian was dead, and carved out his own regime. A Guzang gale prompted his forecast of brief mutiny. Rebels rose and were crushed almost at once.
97
沮渠蒙遜先推建康太守段業為主，光遣其子纂率眾討之。 時論謂業等烏合，纂有威聲，勢必全克。 光以訪羅什，答曰：「此行未見其利。 」既而纂敗于合黎，俄又郭黁起兵，纂棄大軍輕還，復為黁所敗，僅以身免。
Juqu Mengxun's puppet Duan Ye drew Lü Guang's son Lü Zuan against him. Court gossip called Duan Ye rabble and expected Lü Zuan's prestige to crush him. Kumarajiva told Lü Guang the expedition would not pay. Lü Zuan lost at Heli, fled Guo Wu's rising, abandoned his army, and barely escaped.
98
中書監張資病，光博營救療。 有外國道人羅叉，雲能差資病。 光喜，給賜甚重。 羅什知叉誑詐，告資曰：「叉不能為益，徒煩費耳。 冥運雖隱，可以事試也。 」乃以五色絲作繩結之，燒為灰末，投水中，灰若出水還成繩者，病不可愈。 須臾，灰聚浮出，復為繩，叉療果無效，少日資亡。
Lü Guang scoured healers for ailing Zhang Zi. A foreign monk named Luo Cha claimed a cure. Lü Guang showered him with gifts. Kumarajiva warned Zhang Zi that Luo Cha was a fraud wasting treasure. Hidden fate could still be tested, he said. He knotted colored silk, burned it to ash, and floated it—if the ash reknotted into cord, death was certain. The ash reformed as rope; Luo Cha failed and Zhang Zi died within days.
99
頃之，光死，纂立。 有豬生子，一身三頭。 龍出東箱井中，於殿前蟠臥，比旦失之。 纂以為美瑞，號其殿為龍翔殿。 俄而有黑龍升于當陽九宮門，纂改九宮門為龍興門。 羅什曰：「比日潛龍出遊，豕妖表異，龍者陰類，出入有時，而今屢見，則為災眚，必有下人謀上之變。 宜克己修德，以答天戒。 」纂不納，後果為呂超所殺。
Lü Guang died and Lü Zuan took the throne. A sow farrowed a three-headed piglet. A dragon left the east-wing well, coiled before the hall, and vanished by dawn. Lü Zuan hailed it as an omen and renamed the hall Dragon Soaring. A black dragon rose at Dangyang's Nine Palaces gate, so he renamed it Dragon Rising. Kumarajiva read roaming dragons and porcine freaks as yin omens of usurpation. He urged self-discipline to answer heaven's rebuke. Lü Zuan ignored him and fell to Lü Chao's plot.
100
羅什之在涼州積年，呂光父子既不弘道，故蘊其深解，無所宣化。 姚興遣姚碩德西伐，破呂隆，乃迎羅什，待以國師之禮，仍使入西明閣及逍遙園，譯出眾經。 羅什多所暗誦，無不究其義旨，既覽舊經多有紕繆，於是興使沙門僧睿、僧肇等八百餘人傳受其旨，更出經論，凡三百餘卷。 沙門慧睿才識高明，常隨羅什傳寫，羅什每為慧睿論西方辭體，商略同異，云：「天竺國俗甚重文制，其宮商體韻，經入管弦為善。 凡覲國王，必有贊德，經中偈頌，皆其式也。 」羅什雅好大乘，志在敷演，常歎曰：「吾若著筆作大乘阿毗曇，非迦旃子比也。 今深識者既寡，將何所論！ 」惟為姚興著《實相論》二卷，興奉之若神。
Years under the Lüs, who ignored the dharma, left his deepest insight untaught. Yao Xing's general crushed Lü Long, welcomed Kumarajiva as national preceptor, and housed him at Ximing and Free Roaming to translate scripture. He corrected flawed old translations with eight hundred assistants, issuing over three hundred new scrolls. To his scribe Hui Rui he explained Sanskrit rhetoric and musicality. Royal audiences demanded panegyric verse like sutra gathas, he explained. He aspired to author Mahayana abhidharma surpassing the Sarvastivadin masters. He groaned that few peers could debate subtle doctrine. He wrote the two-scroll True Mark treatise for Yao Xing alone, and the emperor worshipped him.
101
嘗講經於草堂寺，興及朝臣、大德沙門千有餘人肅容觀聽，羅什忽下高坐，謂興曰：「有二小兒登吾肩，欲鄣須婦人。 」興乃召宮女進之，一交而生二子焉。 興嘗謂羅什曰：「大師聽明超悟，天下莫二，何可使法種少嗣。 」遂以伎女十人，逼令受之。 爾後不住僧坊，別立解舍。 諸僧多效之。 什乃聚針盈缽，引諸僧謂之曰：「若能見效食此者，乃可畜室耳。 」因舉匕進針，與常食不別，諸僧愧服乃止。
Mid-sermon at Caotang he told Yao Xing two sprites on his shoulders demanded a woman—an occult excuse. Yao Xing sent palace ladies; one liaison produced twin sons. Yao Xing argued that such genius owed the church heirs. He forced ten court entertainers on the monk. Kumarajiva thereafter kept a private lay cloister outside the common dormitory. Lesser monks copied his householding. He filled a bowl with needles and dared the clergy to mimic his feat before taking wives. He ate them like rice until the monks, shamed, dropped the fad.
102
杯渡比丘在彭城，聞羅什在長安，乃歎曰：「吾與此子戲，別三百餘年，相見杳然未期，遲有遇于來生耳。 」羅什未終少日，覺四大不愈，乃口出三番神咒，令外國弟子誦之以自救，未及致力，轉覺危殆，於是力疾與眾僧告別曰：「因法相遇，殊未盡心，方復後世，惻愴可言。 」死于長安。 姚興於逍遙園依外國法以火焚屍，薪滅形碎，惟舌不爛。
The wandering monk Beidu in Pengcheng sighed that he and Kumarajiva had parted three centuries and might reunite only in another life. Days before death he felt his body failing, tried spirit spells through foreign pupils, then rallied to bid the sangha farewell, mourning unfinished dharma work. His life ended in the Jin capital. Yao Xing cremated him Indian-style at Free Roaming Garden; bones shattered but the tongue survived the pyre.
103
僧曇霍
The monk Tanhuo
104
沙門曇霍者，不知何許人也。 禿髮傉檀時從河南來，持一錫杖，令人跪曰：「此是般若眼，奉之可以得道。 」時人咸異之。 或遺以衣服，受而投之於河，後日以還其本主，衣無所汙。 行步如風雲，言人死生貴賤無毫釐之差。 人或藏其錫杖，曇霍大哭數聲，閉目須臾，起而取之，咸奇其神異，莫能測也。 每謂傉檀曰：「若能安坐無為，則天下可定，祚胤克昌，如其窮兵好殺，禍將及己。 」傉檀不能從。 傉檀女病甚，請救療，曇霍曰：「人之生死自有定期，聖人亦不能轉禍為福，曇霍安能延命邪！ 正可知早晚耳。 」傉檀固請之。 時後宮門閉，曇霍曰：急開後門，及開門則生，不及則死。 」傉檀命開之，不及而死。 後兵亂，不知所在也。
Tanhuo's origins were unknown. Under Tufa Nutan he arrived from Henan with a staff, forcing folk to kneel and calling it the eye of wisdom. Onlookers took him for a wonder. Gifts of clothing he flung in the river; the garments returned spotless to the donors on the promised day. He strode like storm wind and never missed a fate he foretold. Hidden staves drew wails until he recovered them by trance, baffling witnesses. He urged Nutan that quiet rule would secure the throne while endless war would rebound on him. Nutan refused the counsel. When Nutan's daughter lay dying, Tanhuo refused miracles, citing fixed life spans even sages cannot bend. He offered only a timetable, not a cure. Nutan insisted. With harem gates locked, Tanhuo demanded the rear portal be opened instantly to spare the princess. Nutan complied too late and the girl died. War swallowed him without trace.
105
台產
Tai Chan
106
台產，字國俊，上洛人，漢侍中崇之後也。 少專京氏《易》，善圖讖、秘緯、天文、洛書、風角、星算、六日七分之學，尤善望氣、占候、推步之術。 隱居商洛南山，兼善經學，泛情教授，不交當世。 劉曜時，災異特甚，命公卿各舉博識直言之士一人。 其大司空劉均舉產。 曜親臨東堂，遣中黃門策問之，產極言其故。 曜覽而嘉之，引見，訪以政事。 產流涕歔欷，具陳災變之禍，政化之闕，辭甚懇至。 曜改容禮之，署為博士祭酒、諫議大夫，領太史令。 至明年而其言皆驗，曜彌重之，轉太中大夫，歲中三遷。 歷位尚書、光祿大夫、太子少師，位特進，金章紫綬，爵關中侯。
Tai Chan, courtesy Guojun, of Shangluo, descended from Han courtier Tai Chong. He mastered Jing Fang's Zhouyi, apocrypha, stars, wind divination, and calendrical computation, excelling at qi-watching and omen math. He taught classics from a hermitage on Shangluo's southern peak, shunning office. Liu Yao, beset by omens, ordered each minister to nominate a candid scholar. Grand Minister Liu Jun nominated Tai Chan. Liu Yao convened him at the east hall for a palace examination, and Tai Chan laid out every cause. The emperor praised his memorials, received him, and sought policy advice. He wept through a thorough brief on portents and policy failures. Liu Yao honored him with erudite libationer, remonstrance grandee, and astrologer-in-chief posts. When every warning proved true within a year, Liu Yao thrice promoted him to grand palace grandee. He rose through minister, palace grandee, heir tutor, special advancement, gold seal purple ribbon, and marquis of Guannei.
107
史評
Closing shǐ píng verdict section.
108
史臣曰：陳戴等諸子並該洽墳典，研精數術，究推步之幽微，窮陰陽之秘奧，雖前代京管，何以加之！ 郭黁知有晉之亡姚，去姚以歸晉，追兵奄及，致斃中途，斯則遠見秋毫，不能近知目睫。 澄什爰自遐裔，來游諸夏。 什既兆見星象，澄乃驅役鬼神，並通幽洞冥，垂文闡教，諒見珍於道藝，非取貴於他山，姚石奉之若神，良有以也。 鮑、吳、王、幸等或假靈道訣，或受教神方，遂能厭勝禳災，隱文彰義，雖獲譏於妖妄，頗有益於世用者焉。 然而碩學通人，未宜枉轡。
The annalist praises Chen Xun, Dai Yang, and their peers as rivaling Han augurs Jing Fang and Guan Lu. Guo Wu foresaw Jin ending Yao yet died fleeing to Jin—sharp on distant detail, blind to the immediate. Fotucheng and Kumarajiva crossed from the frontiers into China. One read the stars, the other bound ghosts; both illumined the dark and spread doctrine, earning Yao and Shi's awe on merit, not novelty. Lesser wonder-workers mixed fraud with practical charms that sometimes helped the folk. True scholars need not hitch their wagons to such arts.
109
贊曰：《傳》敘災祥，《書》稱龜筮。 應如影響，葉若符契。 怪力亂神，詭時惑世。 崇尚弗已，必致流弊。
The verse cites the Zuozhuan and Shangshu on omens and divination. Omens answer like echoes and fit like split tallies. Uncanny powers and rogue spirits bewitch their times. Endless court patronage of such ways invites lasting harm.
